blocks.prompt: 3 (i) Find the coefficient of \(x^{n}\) in the expansion of \(\frac{1 + x^{2}}{(1 + x)^{2}}\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein chand terms nahi, balke ek general formula chahiye: \(x^{n}\) ka coefficient \(n\) ki shakal mein.
Expression ko \((1 + x^{2})(1 + x)^{-2}\) likh sakte hain. Upar wale \(1 + x^{2}\) ki wajah se \(x^{n}\) tak pohanchne ke do raaste hain.
Rule kaunsa? \((1 + x)^{-2}\) ki general term.
Plan: general term nikalna, phir dono raaston ke coefficients jama karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{1 + x^{2}}{(1 + x)^{2}}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(x^{n}\) ka coefficient.
Tareeqa: \(\frac{1 + x^{2}}{(1 + x)^{2}} = (1 + x^{2})(1 + x)^{-2}\). Pehle \((1 + x)^{-2}\) ki general term (r-wi term ka formula) nikalenge. Phir \(x^{n}\) do tarah banta hai: 1 ko \(x^{n}\) wali term se multiply karein, ya \(x^{2}\) ko \(x^{n-2}\) wali term se. Dono ka jama jawab hai. (Series \(|x| < 1\) par valid hai.)

\((1 + x)^{-2}\) ki general term
\[T_{r+1} = \dfrac{(-2)(-3)\cdots(-2 - r + 1)}{r!}x^{r}\]
\[= \dfrac{(-1)^{r}\,2 \cdot 3 \cdots (r + 1)}{r!}x^{r}\]
\[= (-1)^{r}(r + 1)x^{r}\]
Kyun: General term ke upar \(r\) factors hain: \(-2, -3, \dots, -(r + 1)\). Har ek mein minus hai, to \(r\) minus mil kar \((-1)^{r}\) bante hain. Baqi \(2 \cdot 3 \cdots (r + 1)\) asal mein \((r + 1)!\) hai, aur \(\tfrac{(r + 1)!}{r!} = r + 1\), kyunke upar neeche \(1 \cdot 2 \cdots r\) cancel ho jata hai.

Yani series yeh hai
\[(1 + x)^{-2} = 1 - 2x + 3x^{2} - 4x^{3} + \dots\]
Kyun: Formula ki tasdeeq: \(r = 0, 1, 2, 3\) rakhein to coefficients \(1, -2, 3, -4\) aate hain, bilkul jaise part 1(iii) mein mile the.

Pehla raasta: 1 \(\times\) \(x^{n}\) wali term
\[r = n:\ (-1)^{n}(n + 1)\]
Kyun: Upar wala 1 kisi power ko nahi badalta, is liye series ki \(x^{n}\) wali term seedhi \(x^{n}\) deti hai. General term mein \(r = n\) rakh diya.

Doosra raasta: \(x^{2} \times\) \(x^{n-2}\) wali term
\[r = n - 2:\ (-1)^{n-2}(n - 1)\]
\[= (-1)^{n}(n - 1)\]
Kyun: \(x^{2}\) ko \(x^{n-2}\) se multiply karein to powers jama ho kar \(x^{n}\) banta hai. Is liye \(r = n - 2\) rakha: \((n - 2) + 1 = n - 1\). Aur \((-1)^{n-2} = (-1)^{n}\), kyunke \((-1)^{2} = 1\) se divide karne se kuch nahi badalta.
Dhyan dein: yeh doosra raasta bhool jana sab se aam ghalti hai. Upar \(x^{2}\) hai to us ka hissa bhi ginna zaroori hai.

Dono ko jama karein
\[(-1)^{n}(n + 1) + (-1)^{n}(n - 1)\]
\[= (-1)^{n}(2n)\]
Kyun: Dono mein \((-1)^{n}\) common hai. Bracket mein \(n + 1 + n - 1 = 2n\); +1 aur -1 cancel ho gaye.

Tasdeeq
\[n = 2:\ 3 + 1 = 4 = (-1)^{2}(4)\]
\[n = 3:\ -4 - 2 = -6 = (-1)^{3}(6)\]
\[n = 1:\ -2 = (-1)^{1}(2)\]
Kyun: Seedha multiply kar ke dekha to formula se wohi number aaye. \(n = 1\) par \(x^{-1}\) wali term nahi hoti, phir bhi formula \(-2\) deta hai jo sahi hai. Sirf constant term (\(n = 0\)) ke liye coefficient 1 hai, is liye formula \(n \ge 1\) ke liye hai.

blocks.prompt: 3 (ii) Find the coefficient of \(x^{n}\) in the expansion of \(\frac{(1 + x)^{2}}{(1 - x)^{2}}\).
blocks.explanation:
Bilkul part (i) wala tareeqa, bas is dafa upar \((1 + x)^{2} = 1 + 2x + x^{2}\) hai jis mein teen terms hain. Is liye \(x^{n}\) tak pohanchne ke teen raaste banenge.
Find kya karna hai? \(x^{n}\) ka coefficient.
Plan: \((1 - x)^{-2}\) ki general term, phir teeno raaston ka jama.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{(1 + x)^{2}}{(1 - x)^{2}}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(x^{n}\) ka coefficient.
Tareeqa: Upar wala square khol kar aur neeche wali bracket upar la kar \((1 + 2x + x^{2})(1 - x)^{-2}\) likhenge. \(x^{n}\) teen tarah banta hai: \(1 \times x^{n}\), \(2x \times x^{n-1}\), aur \(x^{2} \times x^{n-2}\). (Series \(|x| < 1\) par valid hai.)

\((1 - x)^{-2}\) ki general term
\[T_{r+1} = (-1)^{r}(r + 1)(-x)^{r}\]
\[= (r + 1)x^{r}\]
Kyun: Part (i) mein \((1 + x)^{-2}\) ki general term \((-1)^{r}(r + 1)x^{r}\) thi. Ab \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) hai, to ek aur \((-1)^{r}\) aata hai. \((-1)^{r}(-1)^{r} = (-1)^{2r} = 1\), is liye saare coefficients positive ho gaye.

Yani series yeh hai
\[(1 - x)^{-2} = 1 + 2x + 3x^{2} + 4x^{3} + \dots\]
Kyun: \(r = 0, 1, 2, 3\) rakh kar dekh liya: 1, 2, 3, 4. Yeh series bhi yaad rakhne layak hai.

Teeno raaston ke hisse
\[1 \times (n + 1)\]
\[2 \times n\]
\[1 \times (n - 1)\]
Kyun: Pehla: \(r = n\) se \(n + 1\). Doosra: \(2x\) ko \(x^{n-1}\) chahiye, yani \(r = n - 1\) jis ka coefficient \(n\) hai, aur saath 2 bhi multiply hoga. Teesra: \(x^{2}\) ko \(x^{n-2}\) chahiye, yani \(r = n - 2\), coefficient \(n - 1\).
Dhyan dein: beech wali term \(2x\) ka 2 multiply karna na bhoolein; is ke baghair jawab \(3n\) aa jayega jo ghalat hai.

Tasdeeq
\[n = 1:\ 2 + 2 = 4\]
\[n = 2:\ 3 + 4 + 1 = 8\]
Kyun: Choti values par seedha multiply kar ke wohi 4 aur 8 aaye jo \(4n\) deta hai. Sirf constant term (\(n = 0\)) 1 hai, is liye formula \(n \ge 1\) ke liye hai.
